tasks.verified: A deterministic anaphoric-week override in the gateway: when the patient's verbatim says 'that week'/'same week' and context_date is present, the named weekday resolves inside the context week no matter how extraction verbalized the date, proven at the handler seam and by a grown cumulative suite.
tasks.spec:
ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 52 (anaphoric-week determinism). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys, do not load skills.

CONTEXT - measured defect (6-sample envelope capture against the live stack): after the bot offers 'Wednesday 08/19/2026', the patient says 'What about Monday that week?'. The LLM extractor nondeterministically writes preference_from as 'monday next week' (5 of 6 runs -> gateway resolves from today -> WRONG Monday 08/10) or 'monday the week of 08/19/2026' (1 of 6 -> RIGHT Monday 08/17). The gateway obeys whichever wording it gets. Design rule for this system: extraction nondeterminism must never be load-bearing; deterministic resolution belongs in the gateway, which already receives user_text, user_verbatim and context_date (the currently-offered slot, e.g. '08/19/2026 10:30 am') in every availability request body.

SOURCE - copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR23/gw-vocab2-fix/fixed-bland_gateway.py (this is byte-identical to the deployed lane-51 gateway) into your CWD as fixed-bland_gateway.py and edit that copy. Copy the cumulative test tree /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR23/gw-vocab2-fix/gwtest into ./gwtest and extend it; every existing test must still pass.

THE FIX - implement an anaphoric-week override with this exact contract:
1. TRIGGER (all conditions required): (a) user_verbatim or user_text matches the regex \b(that|the same|same)\s+week\b case-insensitively; (b) context_date parses with the gateway's existing context_date parser; (c) the from-text names a weekday (monday..sunday, any case) OR names no weekday at all (see rule 4).
2. RESOLUTION with a weekday: the target is that weekday inside the Monday-Sunday week containing context_date. This OVERRIDES any qualifier extraction attached - 'monday next week', 'monday the week of 08/12/2026', bare 'monday' all resolve to the context week's Monday. Set the search window to that single day (from == to == target).
3. PAST GUARD: if the target date is before today, do NOT jump to another week; follow the gateway's existing honest-empty path for a day with no availability (zero slots, no error).
4. NO WEEKDAY NAMED ('anything that week?'): resolve the window to the full context week, Monday through Sunday, clipped so from is not before today.
5. NON-TRIGGERS (behavior must remain byte-for-byte unchanged): verbatim lacks the anaphor (e.g. the patient literally said 'monday next week'); context_date missing or unparseable; from-text contains an explicit standalone calendar date and no anaphor in verbatim.
6. Implement the resolution as a pure function taking (from_text, verbatim_text, context_date_str, today) so tests can inject a fixed today; the handler passes the real today. The override must sit at the handler-level resolution seam - the same code path real requests take - not in a helper that requests bypass.

DELIVERABLES in CWD:
- fixed-bland_gateway.py (the edited gateway, full file)
- proof_anaphora.py - executable proof at the handler-level seam printing one line per case, deriving all dates from datetime.date.today() so it stays valid on any run date. Compute ctx = today + 14 days, ctx_str = ctx formatted like a slot start ('%m/%d/%Y 10:30 am'), mon = ctx minus ctx.weekday() days, tue = mon + 1 day. Print exactly these lines with the computed ISO dates:
  CASE=anaphora-next-week-wording FROM=<mon> (inputs: from='monday next week', verbatim='What about Monday that week?', context=ctx_str)
  CASE=anaphora-week-of-wording FROM=<mon> (from='monday the week of ' + ctx date, same verbatim/context)
  CASE=anaphora-wrong-week-of FROM=<mon> (from='monday the week of ' + (ctx - 7 days) date, same verbatim/context - context must win)
  CASE=no-anaphor-next-week FROM=<the Monday of today's next ISO week> (from='monday next week', verbatim='how about monday next week?', context=ctx_str - no override)
  CASE=anaphora-tuesday FROM=<tue> (from='tuesday', verbatim='could we do Tuesday that week', context=ctx_str)
  CASE=anaphora-no-context FROM=<the Monday of today's next ISO week> (from='monday next week', verbatim='What about Monday that week?', context='' - no override)
  CASE=anaphora-no-weekday WINDOW=<max(mon, today)>..<mon + 6 days> (from='that week', verbatim='anything that week?', context=ctx_str)
- ./gwtest extended with at least 8 new tests covering: both wordings resolve identically under the anaphor; wrong week-of qualifier loses to context; past guard via injected today (today=Wednesday, context=Thursday same week, 'monday that week' -> the past Monday -> honest empty, never a different week); no-anaphor unchanged; no-context unchanged; no-weekday full-week window and its today-clipping; regex does not fire on 'that works'.
- DEBUG-GW52.md - what you changed, where the seam is (function names), the exact trigger regex, known limitations (e.g. negated anaphors like 'not that week').

HARD RULES: do not weaken, remove or skip any existing test; do not change any behavior outside the trigger conditions; keep the file runnable as the single gateway module it is; no placeholder or commented-out code.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_anaphora.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -8 proof.out; exit 1; }; mon=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();c=t+d.timedelta(days=14);print((c-d.timedelta(days=c.weekday())).isoformat())"); tue=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();c=t+d.timedelta(days=14);print((c-d.timedelta(days=c.weekday())+d.timedelta(days=1)).isoformat())"); nxt=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print((t+d.timedelta(days=7-t.weekday())).isoformat())"); for c in "CASE=anaphora-next-week-wording FROM=$mon" "CASE=anaphora-week-of-wording FROM=$mon" "CASE=anaphora-wrong-week-of FROM=$mon" "CASE=no-anaphor-next-week FROM=$nxt" "CASE=anaphora-tuesday FROM=$tue" "CASE=anaphora-no-context FROM=$nxt" 'CASE=anaphora-no-weekday WINDOW='; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q 'fortnight' fixed-bland_gateway.py || { echo 'FAIL: lane-51 vocabulary lost from source'; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 99 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests, floor is 99 (91 cumulative + 8 new)"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: anaphoric-week determinism proven - $summary"
